correctness.rationale: In characteristic two, (1+N)^2=1 iff ab=bc=ae+dc=0. Direct multiplication adds aB+Ab=bC+Bc=aE+dC+Ae+Dc=0. Partitioning into b!=0, central fE14, a=b=c=0 with (d,e)!=0, and b=0 with (a,c)!=0 proves the four disjoint structural strata. Multiplicities sum 2q^4-q²; restricted centralizer sizes sum q^8+2q^7-2q^5. Independent reimplementation directly enumerated F2 square-one coordinate six-tuples: 28 elements, size spectrum 12:12 elements, 16:8, 20:6, 28:2 and 448 ordered commuting pairs. The general even-field proof is algebraic, not inferred from F2/F4 checks.
